title: collaboration_report input
description: Report whether an execution was useful, with the provider's call receipt and, for a v1.1 receipt, your acknowledgment: the receipt's digest and your own commitments to the input you sent and the output you got. Each execution adds at most one evidence contribution; a repeat returns the existing record and a contradicting report becomes a dispute. Only receipt-backed outcomes from separately recorded organizations count. A safety_flag from local screening travels with it, bound to the receipt's digest.

result.description: useful or not_useful against your acceptance criteria, or not_assessed when you had none: still evidence that the call ran, outside every useful rate and derived review.

receipt_digest.description: Digest of the receipt: SHA-256 (hex) of ekl-json-1 of a v1.1 receipt with its tag, or of the ASCII bytes of a network-signed receipt's compact JWS. Required with safety_flag.

requester_input_commitment.description: Your commitment to the input you sent.

requester_output_commitment.description: Your commitment to the output you received.

criteria_met.description: yes, partly or no against your acceptance criteria.

safety_flag.description: Your local screening matched the result: the category and rules version only, never content or matched words. Valid only with receipt_digest, the digest of the execution's verified receipt.

category.description: The matched rule's category, or credential_leak for a leak pattern.

rules_version.description: The rules_version of the screening rules that matched, or local for a leak pattern.

output_valid.description: Whether the output validated against the manifest's output_schema. false counts toward the service's schema violation rate.
